title: Stabiliser Box Upper Panel Stiffener Run Extension Between Ribs 4 and 9
abstract: Extends the upper panel stiffener run in the stabiliser box outboard from rib four to rib nine and replaces the associated splice plate, following a fatigue test result that showed the load turning earlier than the original substantiation assumed.

sections.reason: The full scale fatigue article showed strain redistribution at the upper panel splice ahead of the predicted life, with the load turning into the panel skin two bays earlier than the substantiation assumed. Nothing has been found in service, and the in-service inspection covers the area, but the margin at the splice was judged too thin to carry to the end of the design life without a change. The production standard was changed rather than an inspection added, because the affected structure is not accessible without stabiliser removal.
sections.description: The stiffener run on the upper panel is extended outboard from rib four to rib nine using the existing stiffener section, and the splice plate at the rib six joint is replaced by a thicker item with a revised fastener pattern of two rows at twenty-two millimetre pitch. The obsolete stringer at the outboard end of the original run is deleted and its fastener holes are filled with oversize interference fasteners. The rib attachments are unchanged and the box remains interchangeable at assembly level, so the stabiliser can still be exchanged between airframes.
sections.effects: Mass increase of eleven point four kilograms, aft of the centre of gravity, requiring a loading manual reissue but no trim change. No electrical or system effect. Not interchangeable at panel level; the upper panel and splice plate must be changed as a set. The structure repair manual limits for the splice region are narrowed for the post modification standard, and the stabiliser box inspection task is reissued with revised access.
sections.embodiment_note: Production only from MSN M00428. The bulletin exists for one operator that requested embodiment at a stabiliser overhaul; the work is a shop task and is not offered as a line retrofit.

type_data.balance_impact: Aft of the centre of gravity, loading manual reissued
type_data.production_impact: Cut in at MSN M00428, panel supplied to the stabiliser assembly line
